description: This file defines the class OX_Admin_UI_Install_DbForm, which builds and manages a database configuration form for the Revive Adserver installation or upgrade process. It includes methods for constructing form sections, populating form data, and extracting configuration details.

classes.name: OX_Admin_UI_Install_DbForm
classes.description: A class that constructs and manages a database configuration form for installation or upgrade of Revive Adserver.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the form with parameters for translation, action, supported database and table types, and upgrade or timezone error flags.

methods.name: buildMainDbSection
methods.description: Builds the main database settings section of the form.

methods.name: buildAdditionalDbSection
methods.description: Builds the advanced database settings section of the form.

methods.name: buildUpgradeDbViewSection
methods.description: Builds a read-only view of database info during upgrade.

methods.name: buildTimeZoneSection
methods.description: Adds a timezone warning and checkbox to the form.

methods.name: populateDbConfig
methods.description: Extracts form values into a structured database configuration array.

methods.name: populateForm
methods.description: Populates the form with existing database configuration data.
